notes.subject: bana ba bana ba gago
notes.rationale: בנים לבניך moya ka o tee: bana ba bana ba gago (barwa-curu), e sego 'bana ba bana' ka go hlakanela

notes.subject: kagiso go Yisraele
notes.rationale: šalom al Yisrael e ka ba polelo ya go reretše kagiso goba polelo ya modumo; diphetholelo ka moka di ka dumelelana

notes.subject: go motho yo a tšhabago Yahwe
notes.rationale: domela ya kgauswi e tswalana le e ya psalme ya 128

translation: Ee, o bone bana ba bana ba gago; kagiso go Yisraele!
